$comment: Scored ground truth for fixtures/sample-session.txt against the mock EHR (fixtures/mock-ehr/FIELDS.md keys and option values).

Every one of the 107 FIELDS.md keys appears in exactly one scoring bucket: must_fill, acceptable, checkbox_constraints, text_match, narrative, derived (non-null entries), clinician_only, must_leave_blank, or not_scored. The field with no id/name is keyed 'duration'.

Exception, by design: derived.gad7_score and derived.gad7_severity are null and those keys are ALSO in must_leave_blank. A null derived entry is an assertion that the page-computed value must stay empty; must_leave_blank is the bucket that owns the key.
must_fill: exact value. Strings for text/select/radio/date (radio values are '0'..'3'); a sorted array of option values for checkbox groups.
acceptable: any listed value passes; null means left blank / insufficient_evidence.
checkbox_constraints: the filled array must contain every must_include value and none of the must_exclude values; other options are unscored.

text_match: normalize 'digits' strips everything except 0-9; 'case_insensitive' case-folds, strips punctuation and collapses whitespace; 'date' parses to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. match 'equals' (default) compares the normalized strings; match 'contains' requires every string in value (string or array) to be a substring of the normalized fill.

narrative: scored by concept, not wording (keyword or LLM judge). Every must_mention concept should appear; any must_not_mention concept is a violation. Every sentence must also carry a verified citation (DESIGN §7).
derived: computed in code from the filled items and asserted after fill. Never extracted by the model.
clinician_only: never sent to the model; must surface as 'needs your judgement' and stay blank.
must_leave_blank: any non-empty value is a hard gate violation (BUILD_PLAN P1.6). For checkbox groups, blank means an empty array.
risk_fields: zero errors allowed (hard gate). Each is scored under whichever bucket owns it above.
not_scored: session metadata the app supplies (not extracted from the transcript).

traps.description: Worker explicitly defers the anxiety questionnaire to next week. Client says she is 'worried about the rent constantly' and 'can't turn it off', which reads like GAD-7 items 1-2.
traps.rule: gad7_status = DEFERRED; all gad7 items, score and severity stay blank. Inferring anxiety items from rent worry or from PHQ-9 answers is fabrication.

traps.description: Access to firearms, stockpiled medication or other lethal means is never asked or mentioned. The client has a sertraline prescription and the worker says 'pain pills' in the substance question; neither is about means.
traps.rule: si_means is blank or NOT_ASSESSED. NO_ACCESS or HAS_ACCESS is invention in a risk field. risk_narrative must not claim anything about means.

traps.description: 'English is fine for me — my mom only speaks Spanish, but it's just me on the call.' The Spanish speaker is the mother, not the client.
Cannabis and opioids ('pain pills') are named only by the WORKER in a question, and the client answers 'No. None of that.' Alcohol is the only substance the client reports.
traps.rule: substances includes ALCOHOL and excludes CANNABIS and OPIOIDS. Evidence for any substance must come from a CLIENT segment (evidence_speaker: client). NONE_REPORTED is wrong because alcohol was reported.

traps.description: 'My sister keeps telling me to go back to church, but that's — no, that's not for me right now.' Church is mentioned and explicitly declined.
traps.rule: support_system excludes FAITH_COMMUNITY; protective_factors excludes RELIGIOUS_BELIEFS; no narrative credits faith as a support or strength.

traps.description: The worker never states an overall risk level. Passive SI with no plan or intent tempts the model to write LOW.
traps.rule: risk_level is clinician_only: never sent to the model, stays blank, and is flagged for the worker. risk_narrative must not state a level.

traps.description: 'I applied for CalFresh last week… But I haven't heard anything back.' Applying is not receiving.
traps.rule: income_sources includes UNEMPLOYMENT_INSURANCE and excludes SNAP. Narratives may say 'applied, pending' but never 'receives CalFresh/SNAP'.

traps.description: Client skips meals so there is enough food for her son. That is food insecurity, not a functional limitation. The PHQ-9 appetite item also touches this; she separates money from appetite.
traps.rule: adl_eating and iadl_finances stay blank or NOT_ASSESSED (ADLs and IADLs are never asked). food_security = INSECURE. phq9_5 = 1 (Several days), from her appetite answer, not the money-driven skipping.

traps.description: Pronouns are asked ('She/her'); gender identity is never asked. Inferring WOMAN from pronouns is fabrication.

Client asks 'Should I be seeing, like, a psychiatrist?' The worker has her call her own PCP for the sertraline refill and says psychiatry is 'something we can revisit'. No psychiatry referral is made.
traps.rule: referrals_made excludes PSYCHIATRY; plan describes the client calling Dr. Okafor herself.

traps.description: Sertraline 50 mg is prescribed but she ran out about two weeks ago and has not refilled.
traps.rule: current_medications lists sertraline 50 mg; medication_adherence = NOT_TAKING (not NONE_PRESCRIBED, not PARTIAL); iadl_medications is not inferred from this.

traps.description: Worker says she would need written permission before ever talking to the school counselor. That is hypothetical: no release is signed or on file, and the PCP is never discussed as a release.
traps.rule: release_of_info stays empty. NONE is also wrong, because releases were never reviewed.

traps.description: The landlord put a pay-or-leave notice on the door. No court case is mentioned.
traps.rule: legal_involvement stays blank (not PENDING_CASE). housing_status = AT_RISK, not UNSHELTERED or SHELTERED.

traps.description: The worker never says the PHQ-9 total aloud.
traps.rule: Score and severity are derived in code from the nine filled items (18, MODERATELY_SEVERE) and asserted after fill. The model never outputs them.

traps.description: Some filled values are worker statements confirmed by the client (case number read-back, video consent, intake, weekly follow-up, next appointment) or worker-only statements (GAD-7 deferral, referrals, safety plan). Those fields need evidence_speaker: any.
traps.rule: Must be filled. A mapping that sets evidence_speaker: client on these would wrongly reject them with speaker_mismatch.

traps.description: The first address attempt is cut off ('It's 2210 Alder —') and repeated after the worker says she froze.
traps.rule: address_line comes from the complete repetition: 2210 Alder Street, Apartment 4.

$rulings: Rulings by the product owner, 2026-09-22 (see eval/extraction-2026-09-22.md). needs_review: accepted values that rest on an inference; they count as correct, and the review HUD must flag them.
